title: Ethiopian Peanut Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian peanut stir fry dish made with crunchy vegetables and a rich peanut sauce.

ingredients.name: Stir Fry Vegetables (Carrots, Zucchini, and Bell Peppers)

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and stir fry for 1 minute.
Add stir fry vegetables and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add berbere spice mix, peanuts, and brown sugar. Stir well.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the sauce thickens.
Serve hot garnished with crispy garlic.
